provenance.note: The individual awards and the Fair Play Trophy announced after the gold medal match. fih.hockey is unreachable from the environment this was recorded in, so the names were taken from the published announcement and the FIH match centre rather than read from the FIH directly. Every one is then checked against the official FIH team lists this app does hold — nation, position, the top scorer's goal count against our own event ledger, and the fair-play winner's card count against that same ledger — by scripts/test_awards.mjs, which fails the build on any name that does not resolve or any figure that does not match.
provenance.checkedAgainst: public/data/players.json (FIH entry lists) and the fixtures event ledger
